exposure: Pulmonary hypertension (PH) status (assessed via tricuspid regurgitation velocity screening)
cohort: Pregnant women with Sickle Cell Disease (SCD) between 28 and 34 weeks of gestation.
finding: Screening and referral for pulmonary hypertension in pregnant women with Sickle Cell Disease in low- and middle-income countries is feasible, with high protocol adherence and echo uptake, though challenges exist in early diagnosis and postnatal follow-up.
